title: managedAgentTurn
responsibility: Admits a provider turn within a shared lease, reports queue waiting and preserves cancellation semantics.

inputs.name: managedAgentTurn.turn
inputs.description: Requested provider turn with model, access, status callback and cancellation signal.

inputs.name: managedAgentTurn.action
inputs.description: Asynchronous work executed only after admission; receives the bounded resource context.

inputs.name: managedAgentTurn.queue
inputs.description: Shared queue used to track child PID and process start identity under this lease.

outputs.name: managedAgentTurn
outputs.description: Result of the admitted provider operation; queued cancellation launches no provider.

errors.name: RunCancelled
errors.description: Maps queued cancellation to the provider cancellation contract and preserves genuine provider failures.
